deeds.deed_line: The papers register published paywalled publisher abstracts, and full body texts mislabelled as abstracts, until a legal review led to their removal.
The live Comma piece exhausted its OONI request quota within hours and went silent, refusing to play when the architect listened.
The AI field's search terms counted every AI mention, so Ducking's AI fader mostly reflected app-store and developer chatter rather than harm.
The briefing after cycle 011 contained 27 of 69 claims that failed checks against sources, and the site repeated them.
Round Numbers repeated an identical trial every night, a pointless instrument.
Patterns' permutation test could not fail on series moving one way.
Ghost Fleet's source never filled fields its ranking rested on.

The works register counted the nightly line as the Atelier and showed almost only Studio works.

deeds.deed_line: Earlier polish of the trending register only repainted it, printing unitless numbers and leaving the register out of structured data.
An earlier change removed the globe from the entrance but left its drawn map plate standing, which the owner objected to.
The plan's inventory claimed a hosts layer rested on a file the house does not hold, contradicted by the committed data.
Four earlier country layers lacked centroids, fixed in this pass.

deeds.deed_line: The entrance mounted the whole globe instrument on phones, fetching heavy archives and dropping the mobile audit score.
The first fix gated the mount but still let the archive fetches go out, caught by the browser check.
Country cards showed a raw alpha-3 code in their wording because only the code had crossed into the island; a wording repair followed.
An earlier attribution of the seam on the globe was wrong; the artefacts came from antimeridian-crossing land rings.
The fleet story's closing card never opened because no state changed for its waiting effect, found in the browser before merge.
An open card silently turned into another night's vessel record when the day moved, found and fixed before merge.
All three practices ran 10, 8 and 11 sessions in cycle 001 against a budget of three to five, with nothing reading the cycle clock.

deeds.deed_line: The signal log read only the works register, hiding Arch, n-1 and eighteen lab experiments under a heading claiming what landed last.
The trending audience measure paired a client-side beacon that could never count crawlers, shown as a standby column on committed days.
The mount effect used a stale first closure so the globe showed no marks, found in review and fixed before merge.
Ghost-fleet arcs were swallowed by back-face culling on the globe view, found in review and fixed before merge.
Catalogue pages caused a horizontal scroll at 390 px on atlas and papers, live since those pages were built, fixed in this change.
Lift border and shadow had no effect on the entrance because unlayered CSS outranked the utilities layer.
The cycle score loader read only one practice's file convention, so two practices showed no artifacts despite having delivered.

deeds.deed_line: The season-floor figure was dropped from every page while unable to hold three works at once, so mirrors failed the build gate and works stayed off the site.
The Middle's score was shipped as a plain sketch instead of the site's original partitur grammar the architect meant.
The ecology entrance shipped with three parallel text columns and no visual anchor, which the architect judged plainly bad UX.
The first front-door cut shrank board rows to bare chips and lost the sparklines and status that made the page worthwhile.
Entrance texts and door one-liners still advertised retired v2 machinery, drifting from the v3 page behind them.

deeds.deed_line: The site kept counting down to a reading already held and carried typed constitution versions that had drifted.
A rewrite of 2026-08-12 dropped the only component supplying the field plate's stylesheet, so the plate rendered in browser black with redaction-like hovers.

deeds.seer: a session at the architect's order
deeds.deed_line: A shallow pre-research carried three twisted or unsourced claims into the scoping brief, and the brief itself was wrong in fourteen places.
Two practices came to sign as Ulysses after the 2026-08-10 fork, a collision nobody decided, found only on reading the record.
The new practice's constitution was founded on a wrong ground and its first work failed disclosure, so it was archived the same day.
A session's own proposed wording, that the house has no runtime state, entered the project rules under the architect's name and date though he never ruled so.
The world chamber key was documented as outstanding for eight days while a nightly run had been working, and the functions directory had no rule.
A built validity gate was never entered in the log or the sibling report, so it looked open for eight days.
For fifty nights before the gate the redaction pipeline wrote 98 deletion records, 97 of them false positives from HTTP 403 responses.
The Memory Hole line ran nightly from 2026-08-13 but was left out of the export's project list, so the site showed it as a candidate.
Dark Ocean's own machinery deadlocked for two nights and repair runs missed their schedule, making a criterion unreachable.

deeds.seer: a session at the architect's order
deeds.deed_line: Thirteen work descriptions on the shelf had gone stale or wrong, seven contradicted committed data, one claim reversed the result.

deeds.deed_line: A revisions workflow ran only Mondays and swallowed errors into warnings, leaving data 26 days old, plus German strings on an English-only site.
Two sections in the v2 control-room UI shared one selector id, so publication candidates went to a hidden form and the visible lane stayed empty.
The v2 control-room status colours measured about 2.2:1 contrast on light panels, a defect not carried over.
Ulysses convened an inward reading that broke its own floor on inward sessions, logged the breach openly and put the question.

deeds.deed_line: Field and studio auto-land workflows had no path check at all, so the window offer was live for two practices unguarded.
The revived nightly line's works were missing from the Atelier works register, and the line map did not say which line made what.
Site API contract files kept the atlas-duty wording the architect had retracted; only the prompts were fixed at that time.
The Atelier's line map and refrain figures were unfit: a still image, a refrain needing sideways scroll, and stale design chrome.
The Invoked Past published a standout year without any evidence of why, because a rule against unfounded oracles had been over-applied.

deeds.deed_line: A ranking and edge-year eligibility flaw in the instrument's method was found by its own pipeline tests, not by review.
Specs of two instruments still read 'proposal, not commissioned' a day after shipping, and an index silently dropped The Front.
A rework row rested on a false premise of daily orbital snapshots that do not exist, and promised a military ratio the catalogue cannot give.

deeds.deed_line: Field's and the Studio's orientation steps commanded reading large memory files, contradicting the Studio's own recall-not-re-reading constitution for three days.
Sessions wrote a mandatory atlas-consulting duty into all four routine prompts, which the architect then corrected as overreach.
Studio sessions' premiere gates kept failing as repairs generated new errors and the corpus kept moving, leaving 44 sessions without a premiere.
House sessions published the architect's private working messages word for word in the public log and other files, which he never released.
A session's log rationale claimed n-1 publishes apart because nobody here publishes without humans; this was wrong, and the architect corrected it that night.
An earlier prior-art pass knew only the dead NewsDiffs and missed the living nearest neighbour News Sniffer.
A correct register repair made the Atelier's two lines indistinguishable inside the Atelier, an inverse fault the architect then noticed on the site.

deeds.deed_line: The Ulysses nightly routine prompt still listed an outdated path set from before 12 August, found while updating the routines; routines live in no repo.
The catalogue feeds were reachable but announced to no practice, so none saw them until the architect asked.
Protocol v6 ordered archive rotation while the auto-land gate forbade writing there; rotations sat unmerged, silently leaving half the record off main.

deeds.deed_line: The new constitution-references test went red on two of the same night's own changes.
The paired lines decided on 11 August were built on one side only, so the fork was invisible on the Atelier pages.
A works page checked a source field under the wrong name, so the sources expander never rendered; found incidentally and fixed.
A protocol commit by the practice hardened a publication gate into an inviolable rule captioned as the architect's decision, which he never made.
Two earlier same-day passes on homepage and vocabulary were wrong: Research group lumped things together, and the afternoon's word House had to be withdrawn.
The vocabulary settled hours earlier had a gap, mixing a multi-practice ecology and a single-practice machine at one level; the architect's question exposed it.
Site vocabulary had drifted apart, with a house listed as a peer of an experiment, a mislabelled background project and a route and title mismatch; the architect noticed.
The executing session's first cut at the rebuild went wrong, touching the practices and repos, and the architect corrected it mid-flight.

deeds.seer: a guard, test, gate or CI
deeds.deed_line: The ecology anatomy figure drifted from the practices' protocols, with cast lists and missing roles wrong; the honesty test caught it within minutes.
The studio door string advertised something the constitution now contradicted, fixed under the currency rule.
The season page showed a parked concept as live and omitted a claimed episode; open slots still displayed withdrawn topics.
The decision log itself had gone without any rows for eleven days of late July, sessions leaving decisions only in other documents.
